run_requirements: Root G2 acceptance ends and root explicitly releases quota/authorizes start; no guest beforehand.
Same four signed files and source/build/install identity in both runs; no reinstall or code change between runs.
Before a literal per-run sysfs write, verify private PID/process-start/executable/AVD/guest boot UUID/completedboot/kernel/page size; write/readback must succeed and preserve UUID.
Keep pre-write boot reports and any boundary-crossing BH separate; write alone does not flush worker.
10s idle,256MiBx3x8s probe,512MiBx3x8s probe,10s idle; same existing probe binary SHA and phase metadata sampling in both.
No snapshots before comparison complete; no guest pressure/compaction/dropcaches or native gate/granule changes.
Actual subprocess normal stop receipt and frozen log required before second guest starts.
metrics: actual SG count/byte-length/derived-order and unique physical ranges, candidate bytes and skip reasons, not just configured minimum
resident and cold commits, oldobject identity/refcount/PRESENT, HVA outcome, counter windows and all errors, cumulative and unique values separately
perBH pop/ack/SG/reclaimcall counts, attempts/inspections/bytes, exact matching phases, pause API interval and complete callback body when instrumented
memory probe live/zero/reuse result, guard/livecheck errors, unchanged boot/process identity, UUID-path cleanup
sameboot phase-correlated order/buddy/pagetype/zoneinfo/meminfo/vmstat and initialboot report baseline

full_bh_measurement.prepared_observer_design: One reviewed opt-in outer wrapper times the unchanged original BH body, carries local sequence only, includes initial allocation through existing final timing log and cleanup, emits after body return with no device-pointer read after unref. Build/sign/freeze once before both runs.
full_bh_measurement.excluded: Wrapper lookup/timestamps and new envelope emission; scheduler waiting and exact per-vCPU off-run time remain unmeasured.
full_bh_measurement.fallback: If current binary is reused without new observer, report only existing intervals and mark complete-body unavailable; no relabeling.
